question: In the frozen ordered two-point target queries, when does the publicly testable reduced relation P1+2P2=O first occur, compared with each rational-lift arm's first relation?
public_input: same generator G and public point Q as both parent panels; P_i=Q-t_i G; no scalar is used by the direct relation test
direct_test: for every admissible pair compute P1+2P2 and check O, recording first one-based query index and t pair
comparison: join first rational relation query index from each frozen parent result, keeping absent hits as null
claim_boundary: exact first-hit and group-operation control for the fixed two-point coefficient vector (1,2); no wall-time or general xedni complexity claim
